verdict.rationale: npm's own docs confirm it creates and installs from a lock file, including after switching registries, and a community comment confirms an `npm ci` install command exists. Nothing in the pack documents that a lockfile install guarantees identical resolved versions across machines. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that lockfile installs pin exact resolved versions, documentation of `npm ci`'s strict lockfile behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-machine reproducibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install dependencies from a lockfile and get the exact same resolved versions on every machine

citations.quote: If you create a lock file while using the default registry you can switch to another registry and npm will install packages from the new registry
I absolutely loathe npm ci when checking out another branch.
